$comment: Generated by pnpm features:sync from packages/features/src/registry.ts. Only config.deployment and config.features are constrained.

deployment.description: Which product this install is. Only OpenWork Cloud sets "cloud". Renders DEN_DEPLOYMENT.

cloudAgentGateway.description: Cloud agents use the organization AI Gateway: Choose and run cloud-agent models through the organization's AI Gateway access instead of the runner's shared model credentials. Renders DEN_FEATURE_CLOUD_AGENT_GATEWAY.

liveProviderSync.description: Live provider sync: Keep desktop OpenCode v2 models up to date with the organization's AI Gateway in real time. Renders DEN_FEATURE_LIVE_PROVIDER_SYNC.

offlineRecovery.description: Connection failure presentation: Show compact App connection failures and a discreet offline indicator in OpenCode v2 conversations. Renders DEN_FEATURE_OFFLINE_RECOVERY.

secureSecretFields.description: Secure keys in chat: When an agent sets up a connection, plugin or AI Gateway provider that needs keys, people enter them in private fields in the chat and the agent continues once they are saved. Key fields across OpenWork and OpenWork Cloud can be shown while typing and show saved keys as Replace rows. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SECURE_SECRET_FIELDS.

modelsAnalyticsUi.description: Models analytics: Organization admins can view Models & usage analytics and shared model usage limits. Deprecated 2026-10-14: UI hidden behind modelsAnalyticsUi (default off). Most likely delete within 4 weeks (by 2026-11-11) unless an org depends on it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MODELS_ANALYTICS_UI.

taskAnalyticsUi.description: Task analytics: Members with analytics access can view task activity and consumption, and admins can configure analytics integrations. Deprecated 2026-10-14: UI hidden behind taskAnalyticsUi (default off). Most likely delete within 4 weeks (by 2026-11-11) unless an org depends on it. Renders DEN_FEATURE_TASK_ANALYTICS_UI.

managedDeployments.description: Managed deployments: Organization admins install OpenWork in their own AWS account or Google Cloud project and see its health and updates in OpenWork, and agents connected to OpenWork can create and follow those deployments. Renders DEN_FEATURE_MANAGED_DEPLOYMENTS.

slackAssistant.description: Slack Assistant: Answers Slack mentions and DMs for the organization after the Slack connector is set up. Renders DEN_FEATURE_SLACK_ASSISTANT.

workbotTeamLinks.description: Workbot: team settings links: Members with team management access can open their organization's Workbot settings and app connections from Workbot. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_TEAM_LINKS.

workbotFirstRun.description: Workbot: first sign-in: People signing in to Workbot choose or create their workspace without leaving sign-in, with a clear next action when Workbot is unavailable. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_FIRST_RUN.

workbotInlineConnect.description: Workbot: connect accounts: Members connect their assigned apps directly from Workbot and return to the same view after consent. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_INLINE_CONNECT.

workbotDocuments.description: Workbot Documents: Members browse recent Google Drive files and folders in Workbot, open documents in tabs, and save supported text and spreadsheet edits to Drive. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_DOCUMENTS.

workbotWorkspaceAssistant.description: Workbot: workspace assistant: Members ask Workbot about the document or calendar view they have open, chat without leaving their work, and navigate from a compact sidebar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_WORKSPACE_ASSISTANT.

workbotGuidedNavigation.description: Workbot: show me in the workspace: Workbot offers to open the documents it mentions, and the conversation stays open beside the document. Needs the workspace assistant. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_GUIDED_NAVIGATION.

automationCalendar.description: Calendar: desktop app: Members see a Calendar in the desktop app with their Automations next to meetings from their connected Google or Outlook calendar. Renders DEN_FEATURE_AUTOMATION_CALENDAR.

workbotMobile.description: Workbot: phone app: Members can sign in to the Workbot app on iPhone and Android and use Workbot there. Needs Workbot. Renders DEN_FEATURE_WORKBOT_MOBILE.

engineV2ForceUpgrade.description: Upgrade everyone to OpenCode v2: Desktop and web instances copy chats with a backup and switch to OpenCode v2 automatically when idle, without asking for consent. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ENGINE_V2_FORCE_UPGRADE.

engineV2Upgrade.description: Desktop: upgrade prompt to OpenCode v2: Desktop members still on OpenCode v1 see a short notice offering to upgrade: their chats are copied to v2 with a backup, then OpenWork switches engines. Renders DEN_FEATURE_ENGINE_V2_UPGRADE.

remoteSessionEvents.description: Remote session events: MCP clients can subscribe to changes in their remote session receipts and read the current state after reconnecting. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_EVENTS.

remoteSessionSubagents.description: Desktop: tasks on other computers as sub-agents: A task the agent starts on the cloud or another computer shows in the chat like a sub-agent: whether it is working, needs an answer or finished, and its conversation, which people can open, follow up on and stop. Renders DEN_FEATURE_REMOTE_SESSION_SUBAGENTS.

headlessDurableTurns.description: Workbot: tasks keep going on their own: Workbot, Slack and Automations answers keep going after a restart, deploy or server failure, without waiting for someone to reopen the chat. Renders DEN_FEATURE_HEADLESS_DURABLE_TURNS.
